author: Ladykillerxo
quote:
Unplayable. Unenjoyable. Tedious. Boring. Sloppy. 
This game is actively designed to undermine the players agency. Forcing them to do repetitive and tedious chores. It is Nothing Like older GTA. And is created with an intention to Mock and Lecture everyone who enjoy GTA games. 
All the original Founders left Rockstar in 2020, and the soul of GTA left with them. This game which is turning out to be the Most Boring High Budget game launched in decades.
